findings_and_disposition.finding: Switch CioOn duplicated per-port is not necessarily worst-case overshoot
findings_and_disposition.action: Per-port IBIS C_comp+package facts and capacitance sensitivity required; resistor revised to680ohm. Initial1MHz/weak-drive/SLOW only; fast-source stresses remain visible.

findings_and_disposition.finding: HPD analysis originally tied Core and local3V3 power-off together
findings_and_disposition.action: Independent rail-collapse case exposed filter-capacitor injection; added10k resistor at Core input and reran powered levels/offrail sensitivity. No unsupported GPIO injection-current guarantee.

findings_and_disposition.finding: Low ESR can reduce buck phase margin; minimum C7 ESR unspecified
findings_and_disposition.action: Added2mohm combined corner and250ms hold; small modeled phase margin remains a limitation rather than declaring all-corner stability.

findings_and_disposition.finding: C11 effective MLCC capacitance may be below tolerance-only value
findings_and_disposition.action: Requested6.6uF effective-capacitance/slow-loop sensitivity for actual0->5->10mA load.

findings_and_disposition.finding: Corrupt-looking socket rendering does not establish collision
findings_and_disposition.action: Used official Core STEP component bounds; swept mounting pose, lowered HDMI capacitor/ESD bodies, retained manufacturer-mounted-height uncertainty.

findings_and_disposition.finding: Whole-Core DDR3 and final GPU functionality are not implemented in related repositories
findings_and_disposition.action: Reviewed Linux source/DeviceTree/mockdriver and GPU RTL separately. FactoryDDR test is a bringup reference, not proof of final GPU/DDR functionality.

not_waived: Core/local-rail asynchronous collapse and unprovided GPIO injection rating
publication_scope: Fabrication conditions and simulation evidence, not production qualification or measured PoC success
